description: Main entry point for the FastAPI backend of the Tic Tac Toe game with various API endpoints for user registration, authentication, game creation, and game management.

methods.name: register_user(user_data: UserCreate)
methods.description: Register a new user and return user information, raises HTTP 400 if email is already registered.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends())
methods.description: Login to get access token, raises HTTP 401 if email or password is incorrect.

methods.name: create_game(opponent_id: int, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Create a new Tic Tac Toe game with a specified opponent and return game details.

methods.name: make_move( game_id: int, move: GameMove, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Make a move in an ongoing game, verifies turn, validates the move, and updates game state.

methods.name: get_game(game_id: int, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve the current state of a specific game.

methods.name: get_game_history(current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Get the game history for the current user.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple health check endpoint to verify the API is alive.

ctags.name: create_game
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_game(opponent_id: int, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):$/

ctags.name: get_game
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_game(game_id: int, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):$/

ctags.name: make_move
ctags.signature: ( game_id: int, move: GameMove, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
